_comment: Reference values for rdkit-conformer-cluster (RDKit 2024.9.5, ETKDGv3 randomSeed=0xf00d numConfs=50, MMFF94 numThreads=1 maxIters=2000, GetConformerRMSMatrix prealigned=False, Butina 1.0 A reordering; target = 3-phenoxypropanoic acid O=C(O)CCOc1ccccc1). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: ETKDGv3 with fixed seed is deterministic for a given RDKit version/platform; 5 oracle runs identical (spread 0). Verifier recomputes MMFF energy per submitted conformer, re-optimizes each (kills un-optimized submissions), re-clusters from the SDF (kills fabricated cluster counts), and regenerates the pinned-seed ensemble matching energies per conformer (kills different-seed honest ensembles). per_conformer tol 0.001 covers SDF coordinate precision (~3e-5 observed); min-energy ref tolerance = physical minimum resolution. Asset integrity: sha256 of target.smi pinned and validated before all checks (P2 B1 convention); cheat_asset_tamper.sh confirms a tampered target is a hard fail.
